scenes.name: Japanese prog
scenes.angle: Kenso and Ain Soph's 70s studio sessions through Koenjihyakkei's zeuhl export and Tokyo's current underground — one unbroken line.

scenes.name: Zeuhl / Canterbury descendants
scenes.angle: Magma 1969 and the Canterbury cafés through to today's carriers in France, Japan and beyond.

scenes.name: Scandinavian
scenes.angle: What Norway/Sweden/Finland are pressing right now: post-rock melancholy, jazz-trained players, small-label cooperatives.

scenes.name: Latin American
scenes.angle: Current Argentinian/Chilean/Mexican prog and fusion output; one root (e.g. MIA-era Buenos Aires) allowed if it explains the sound.

scenes.name: Eastern European
scenes.angle: Today's Polish/Czech/Hungarian scenes — festivals, listener clubs, and new bands carrying the 70s heritage forward.

scenes.name: Israel / Middle East
scenes.angle: The active Tel Aviv prog/jazz axis and its diaspora — current releases, one root permitted.

scenes.name: Australian / NZ
scenes.angle: What Melbourne/Sydney/Auckland are releasing now: psych-festival culture and jazz-fusion collectives.

scenes.name: East Asian jazz
scenes.angle: Seoul/Tokyo/Shanghai jazz-fusion as it stands this year — technically luminous, culturally restless.

scenes.name: Rock In Opposition
scenes.angle: PROPOSAL: The 1978 movement (Henry Cow, Univers Zero, Present) to today's ReR/Cuneiform torch-carriers.

scenes.name: Canterbury scene 1970–1975
scenes.angle: PROPOSAL: One scene, five years — the Whitstable pubs, Soft Machine splits, and the scene's peak run.

scenes.name: Paris 1970: the year zeuhl arrived
scenes.angle: PROPOSAL: City-and-year — Paris 1970, Kobaïa lands, French rock reorganizes around Magma.

scenes.name: Lead bass: Chapman Stick & fretless traditions
scenes.angle: PROPOSAL: Instrument tradition — Stick/fretless/8-string players carrying the melody, Levin to today's Bandcamp soloists.

scenes.name: Jazztronica
scenes.angle: PROPOSAL: Synth beds under jazz improvisation — the continuum from the 90s Nordic wave to today's practitioners.

scenes.name: Dark Jazz
scenes.angle: PROPOSAL: Bohren-grade noir — slow horns, film-noir air, and who keeps it alive now.

scenes.name: Math-rock
scenes.angle: PROPOSAL: Louisville origins via toe/TTNG to current Bandcamp tremolo-pickers.

scenes.name: Kraut Revival
scenes.angle: PROPOSAL: Motorik 2026 — who is actually channeling Neu!/Can rather than name-checking them.

scene_rotation.note: index = week_counter mod len. Each entry carries mode (lineage|living|moment|microgenre) + angle. The agent may argue a different mode for the week if the harvest supports it; record scene_mode + scene_reason in state.playlists[] and edition.json. proposed:true entries are suggestions pending Gene's approval.
